description: Single source of truth for the Emscripten toolchain pin and compile/link flags. Consumed by wasm_renderer/build.sh (via scripts/format-wasm-compile-flags.js), wasm_renderer/CMakeLists.txt (file(READ) + string(JSON)), scripts/emcc-version-gate.sh and the CI wasm job (setup-emsdk version must equal emsdkVersion). Export lists live in wasm_exports.json. ASYNCIFY is required by device.cpp WaitAny init — see wasm_renderer/BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md before touching it. GROWABLE_ARRAYBUFFERS=0 is deliberate (TextDecoder + resizable heap); do not flip without a Dawn re-test.
